3. Many of Amazon’s Black Friday and Cyber Monday “Deals” Offered No Savings

Source: HackerNews | Topic: hn | Coverage: 1 source | Discussion

Summary

A Groundwork Collaborative investigation found that nearly one-third of Amazon's advertised Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals provided no actual savings to consumers. The study highlights the prevalence of misleading pricing strategies during major retail sales events.

My Take

Amazon selling us 'deals' that aren't deals is about as shocking as finding out the cake is a lie. It's essentially a psychological experiment in how much 'discount' font we can handle before we lose all sense of fiscal responsibility. Always check the price history, because the only thing getting a discount during the holidays is your common sense.
